scope: Three complete local static contracts; no runtime oracle or whole-file compatibility claim
abi: cdecl supported by plain RET and observed R17 caller cleanup; DWORD entry stack arguments; EAX machine result; no prototype edits

effects_order: Store raw error DWORD to de2f90
Scan 45 eight-byte rows from ad8dc0 to ad8f28 exclusive; first exact DWORD key match writes paired DWORD value to de2f8c
Only after no match: unsigned 0x13..0x24 =>13, unsigned 0xbc..0xca =>8, otherwise22 to de2f8c
For misses above 0xca the body transiently writes 8 before 22
functions.return: Incidental EAX=mapped value on hit or ad8f28 on miss; observed callers ignore it
functions.registers: ECX retains raw error; EDX matching row index or 45; no calls or direct nonvolatile-register writes
functions.table: Original rows private; structure, extent and digest in sites evidence
functions.limits: Fixed globals do not establish errno API or thread ownership; unsynchronized writes

functions.descriptor: F<unsigned DWORD[de43e0]; page=DWORD[de42e0+4*(signed(F)>>5)]; entry offset=8*(F&31); BYTE entry+4 bit0x01 required
functions.handle_call: 0094fded(F); result -1 sets DWORD[de2f8c]=9 then returns -1; no local de2f90 write on that path
functions.os_call: SetFilePointer(handle,offset_raw32,NULL,method_raw32); no local method/offset validation or high-distance output
functions.api_error: Only result 0xffffffff consults GetLastError; nonzero error passes to 0094b2a0 and returns -1 without local flag clear
functions.accepted: All non-0xffffffff results, plus 0xffffffff when GetLastError()==0: reload page pointer, AND BYTE entry+4 with 0xfd, return raw API result
functions.ambiguity: Accepted result 0xffffffff and failure both return -1; no SetLastError(0) before API call
functions.preservation: Locally saves/restores EBX/ESI/EDI; EBP untouched; callee ABI remains boundary
functions.R17_context: Caller passes(F,-1,1), ignores return; restoration of lookahead byte is an attempted seek, not guaranteed
functions.limits: No local cache/buffer reset or retry; actual handle movement and descriptor concurrency/lifetime external

effects_order: Increment DWORD[de3144] modulo 2^32 without LOCK before allocation/stream access
Call 00944e46(0x1000); store returned pointer DWORD to stream+8
Nonzero: OR DWORD flags+c with 8; set DWORD size+18=0x1000
Zero: OR DWORD flags+c with 4; replace DWORD base+8 with stream+14; set DWORD size+18=2
Reload base+8 to EAX; clear DWORD count+4; set DWORD cursor+0=base
functions.return: Selected base in EAX, despite decompiler void signature; no local -1 result; R17 caller ignores return
functions.limits: No old buffer release, old flag clear, buffer-byte initialization, existing ownership/capacity check, or direct I/O. Allocation implementation and eventual release remain boundaries
